crossRefs.note: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…

people.name: Eliab
people.line: Son of Helon, leader of the tribe of Zebulun

people.name: Helon
people.line: Father of Eliab, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun.

translations.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
translations.bsb: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab son of Helon.
translations.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
translations.asv: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Eliab the son of Helon.
